scientific_question: Does continuous symmetric geographic co-opportunity predict excess post-IBD source-to-target spatial recurrence after dyad-specific recurrence expected from sampling geometry under lineage-private spatial worlds is removed?

actual_operator.source_response: endpoint-safe post-IBD residual turnover, then inherited length-orthogonalized training response
actual_operator.source_to_target_skill: Spearman correlation between the 500-km single-source Gaussian field prediction and target post-IBD turnover
actual_operator.graph_rule: inherited frozen density-scaled graph; no rewiring

geometry_null_center.private_world_definition: simulate_genetic_distance_world with shared_fraction=0, ibd_strength=1, noise_sd=0.10, transition_width=0.20, noise_dimensions=2 on exact frozen geometry
geometry_null_center.definition: mu0_st = equal-weight mean across private-amplitude cells of the within-cell mean T_st
geometry_null_center.scientific_role: deterministic response-blind subtraction of dyad-specific recurrence induced by deployment geometry under the declared private family; it is not an estimate of the empirical private amplitude and does not itself provide Type-I control

centered_estimand.primary_model: E_st = exact source FE + exact target FE + beta_G z(G_st) + frozen controls + error_st

inference.calibration: least-favourable one-sided Monte Carlo envelope across private amplitudes after applying the same fixed mu0_st center to every observed/reference/evaluation T_st matrix

positive_world.name: globally_shared_place_A2
positive_world.rationale: all lineages inherit the same continuous boundary field; higher geographic co-opportunity should make that shared place information more reusable

pass_rule.private_cells: each amplitude <=5 rejections among 50 evaluation worlds at envelope p<=0.05
pass_rule.positive_cell: at least 35 rejections among 50 globally_shared_place_A2 worlds
pass_rule.if_fail: close this v0.3 fixed-T_st centering estimator; do not tune radius, G definition, controls, centering weights, amplitudes, or seeds on these worlds
pass_rule.if_pass: run the predeclared formal qualification below with disjoint namespaces; screen itself never authorizes empirical opening

gates.private_type1: for every private amplitude, Wilson 95% upper bound of envelope-p<=0.05 rejection rate <=0.10
gates.positive_power: globally_shared_place_A2 Wilson 95% lower bound of envelope-p<=0.05 rejection rate >=0.80

confirmatory_transition: remove inadmissible species without replacement or graph repair
recompute G_st and declared controls on exact survivor geometry without genetic response
rerun TTF-Q information gate on survivor dyads
rerun this exact fixed-T_st formal qualification on survivor geometry with a separately frozen confirmatory-survivor seed namespace
only then authorize one-shot confirmatory nucleotide-identity opening
forbidden: opening confirmatory nucleotide identity before survivor qualification
choosing a private amplitude after empirical response
weighting private amplitudes according to empirical fit
changing G_st radius or definition after any T_st response is opened
subgroup selection by empirical genetic score
using asymptotic two-way cluster p-values as the primary decision
reusing screen worlds as formal reference or evaluation worlds
